[8:41PM] #OjoduBerger #TrafficUpdate 

Otedola Bridge to Berger, Kara, and OPIC is moving smoothly in both directions. However, Isheri Olowora to Kosoko is experiencing slow but moving traffic due to commercial activities and traffic alternation. On the other hand, routes like VIS, Omole Gate, Omole Junction, and Excellence Yaya Abatan are moving well. 

The return trip from Wempco to Odo Eran and Caterpillar is also smooth, with no impediments or accidents reported. Traffic personnel are on ground managing the situation.
